content: Human-labeling session — econ-cash-reserve-management:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is the tightest treasury drill with seed-rotated base latitude. You hold a Construction Yard (fact), Ore Refinery (proc), Allied Barracks (tent) and Power Plant (powr) — at either the NORTH (y=14) or SOUTH (y=28) latitude, the seed picks — with two harvesters on matching near ore patches and $1500 starting cash. Within about 12 turns, grow the base to at least seven buildings, keep both harvesters alive, and finish with at least $500 in the bank.
